pl.title: Uwaga! W czwartek po południu oraz wieczorem mogą wystąpić burze i silny wiatr. Ostrzeżenie IMGW dla powiatu legionowskiego
pl.description: Instytut Meteorologii i Gospodarki Wodnej wydał ostrzeżenie przed burzami i silnym wiatrem, które mogą wystąpić w czwartek (23 lipca) po południu oraz wieczorem na terenie powiatu legionowskiego. Instytut Meteorologii i Gospodarki Wodnej (IMGW) wydał dla powiatu legionowskiego ostrzeżenie meteorologiczne I stopnia. Prawdopodobieństwo wystąpienia burz oceniono na 80% – Prognozuje się wystąpienie burz z opadami deszczu do 30 mm. IMGW przewiduje, że burzom, które mogą wystąpić w powiecie legionowskim, może towarzyszyć wiatr w porywach osiągający wartość do 65 km/h. Lokalnie możliwy grad – czytamy w komunikacie IMGW w Warszawie. Ostrzeżenie obowiązuje dzisiaj (23 lipca) od godziny 12:00 do godz. 22:00. Ostrzeżenie meteorologiczne pierwszego stopnia przewiduje warunki sprzyjające wystąpieniu niebezpiecznych zjawisk meteorologicznych, które mogą powodować straty materialne oraz zagrożenie zdrowia i życia. Prowadzenie działalności w warunkach narażenia na działanie tych czynników jest utrudnione i niebezpieczne. Zalecana jest ostrożność oraz śledzenie komunikatów i rozwoju sytuacji pogodowej. mx.title: Movistar te deja ver Netflix, Disney+, Max o Apple TV pagando menos durante varios meses
mx.description: Como cliente de Movistar , a lo mejor te interesa reunir cada una de las plataformas de streaming que disfrutas ahora dentro de tu tarifa combinada. Si todavía no has contratado ningún paquete de TV para añadir streaming a tu plan combinado, entonces tienes más de una oferta esperándote en el operador azul. HBO Max, Netflix, Disney+ ... estas son algunas de las alternativas de streaming que hay disponibles dentro del catálogo de «Cine y Series» de la operadora. Eso sí, solamente está disponible para los clientes convergentes (ya sean miMovistar o Fusión). Si en tu caso, como abonado, todavía no has contratado ninguno de estos planes, lo cierto es que el operador español tiene más de un descuento temporal para que veas el mejor streaming pagando menos. Aunque ten claro que este tipo de ofertas que veremos a continuación, no están disponibles para todos los clientes de la operadora azul. El streaming de oferta en Movistar El operador Movistar tiene más de una oferta para los clientes convergentes con una tarifa miMovistar (o Fusión). Ahora bien, tienen que cumplir un requisito sí o sí: que sean altas nuevas en esta serie de paquetes de TV. Así lo explica el operador: « Te informo de que este descuento únicamente se aplica para altas nuevas de estos servicios, por lo que no deben haber tenido previamente contratado ninguno de estos paquetes «. Si tienen ya contratada alguna de estas alternativas o acaban de darse de baja, lo cierto es que no podrán disfrutar de los siguientes descuentos que tiene en activo ahora mismo la compañía telefónica: » Netflix Netflix Estándar con anuncios: por 5,24 euros al mes durante 6 meses – luego sube a 6,99 euros (desde el 27 de julio sube a 8,99 euros) Netflix Estándar: por 10,49 euros al mes durante 6 meses – luego sube a 13,99 euros al mes (desde el 27 de julio sube a 14,99 euros al mes) Netflix Premium: por 14,99 euros al mes durante 6 meses – luego sube a 19,99 euros al mes (desde el 27 de julio sube a 21,99 euros al mes) Se aplica una rebaja del 25 % en cada uno de estos planes de Netflix que se pueden añadir a una tarifa miMovistar. Sin embargo, el precio cambiará desde el 27 de julio, pero se seguirá aplicando el mismo descuento sobre el nuevo precio.

mx.title: La salida de Ferran Torres del Barça se calienta: su renovación es ya muy complicada
mx.description: En el Barça comienzan a ver la situación de Ferran Torres como muy complicada. sg.title: Egypt Launches New Digital Visa-On-Arrival System for a Faster, Seamless Arrival Experience
sg.description: CAIRO , July 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Egyptian Ministry of Tourism & Antiquities today announced a new Digital Visa-on-Arrival System, a key step forward in modernizing entry procedures for international travelers. The pilot phase of the new system will begin on 1 August 2026 at Cairo International Airport (all arrival terminals) , the first of a nationwide rollout to other airports. A Faster, Fully Digital Entry Experience The system replaces the traditional paper visa sticker with a Visa QR Code, offering a faster, seamless arrival that reflects Egypt's commitment to smart, traveler-friendly experiences. How It Works Travelers can get their Visa QR Code via: The official online portal (live 48 hours before the pilot) The dedicated official mobile application Self-Service Machines at Cairo Airport's arrival halls The code can be generated before departure, mid-flight, or after landing, by the traveler or a travel agency. Officers scan it with the passport at the border, shown by email or printed. Each code stays valid for 48 hours from issuance. Pricing is set at USD 36 total : USD 30 current visa fee plus a USD 6 issuing fee. During the pilot, the digital system runs alongside the existing paper visa; once concluded, the sticker is phased out and the QR code becomes the sole entry method. Looking Ahead After the Cairo pilot, the government will extend the system to other airports in stages, with dates announced in advance. The Ministry encourages the travel industry to share this information with customers. About the Egyptian Tourism Authority Established in 1981, the Egyptian Tourism Authority (ETA) promotes Egypt's diverse tourism assets and fosters domestic tourism nationwide. ph.title: Egypt Launches New Digital Visa-On-Arrival System for a Faster, Seamless Arrival Experience
ph.description: CAIRO , July 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Egyptian Ministry of Tourism & Antiquities today announced a new Digital Visa-on-Arrival System, a key step forward in modernizing entry procedures for international travelers. The pilot phase of the new system will begin on 1 August 2026 at Cairo International Airport (all arrival terminals) , the first of a nationwide rollout to other airports. A Faster, Fully Digital Entry Experience The system replaces the traditional paper visa sticker with a Visa QR Code, offering a faster, seamless arrival that reflects Egypt's commitment to smart, traveler-friendly experiences. How It Works Travelers can get their Visa QR Code via: The official online portal (live 48 hours before the pilot) The dedicated official mobile application Self-Service Machines at Cairo Airport's arrival halls The code can be generated before departure, mid-flight, or after landing, by the traveler or a travel agency. Officers scan it with the passport at the border, shown by email or printed. Each code stays valid for 48 hours from issuance. Pricing is set at USD 36 total : USD 30 current visa fee plus a USD 6 issuing fee. During the pilot, the digital system runs alongside the existing paper visa; once concluded, the sticker is phased out and the QR code becomes the sole entry method. Looking Ahead After the Cairo pilot, the government will extend the system to other airports in stages, with dates announced in advance. The Ministry encourages the travel industry to share this information with customers. About the Egyptian Tourism Authority Established in 1981, the Egyptian Tourism Authority (ETA) promotes Egypt's diverse tourism assets and fosters domestic tourism nationwide. Guests are then welcomed with an exquisite Hamachi, Scallion and Chicken Rice Tart , where delicate slices of fresh Hamachi crown a crisp golden shell filled with fragrant chicken rice, topped off with caviar for a luxurious, savoury finish. The signature main dish presents Boston Lobster with Urban Farm Basil and Sticky Rice Cake , paying homage to the evolution of satay sauce. Confited in house-made lobster oil before being delicately char-grilled, the lobster is paired with a deeply flavourful sauce enriched with lobster broth, preserved radish and fresh basil harvested from the hotel's Urban Farm. ph.title: Ginebra, Magnolia eye breakthrough
ph.description: Perennial contenders Barangay Ginebra and Magnolia look to overcome early struggles as they continue to seek their respective first wins against separate foes in the PBA Season 50 Governors’ Cup at the Araneta Coliseum on Friday, July 24. Both still groping for form, the Hotshots look to finally barge into the win column and snap a two-game dry spell when they take on the Meralco Bolts in the first offering at 5:15 p.m. The Kings, meanwhile, are looking to erase the bitter memories of their rusty start when they also seek their first win against the surprising Blackwater Bossing in the second game at 7:30 p.m. For Magnolia, the team is looking for a sense of urgency from its players, especially that it cannot afford to fall into a 0-3 record again just like in the previous conference. “Kailangan mag-adjust. Nangyari na ‘to. As a veteran kailangan mag usap-usap sa mga adjustment namin, kung ano yung kailangan namin,” said veteran guard Mark Barroca after the 81-89 loss to Blackwater. Import KJ Buffen, for one, is still adjusting to the PBA brand of play. “May konting adjustments lang siguro kasi minsan, hindi niya pa alam yung... kung siya pupwesto. Saan ‘yung mismatches,” he added. Likewise, still adjusting to playing without Justin Brownlee, Barangay Ginebra is hoping to put up a better fight after absorbing a 78-81 defeat against Phoenix. Import Riley Grigsby made a good account of himself with 42 points and 13 rebounds but will need more from the Kings locals with Jeremiah Gray only the best scoring local with nine points. But Blackwater isn’t a pushover just judging their first three games of the season-ending conference. The Bossing could have even been on a 3-0 slate after pushing the Bolts to the limit before folding in the end, 114-116. “You have to give Blackwater credit. We’re up 18 but they have no quit and that’s a testament to what coach Pat Aquino has been doing there. They’re playing really well,” he added.

ph.title: DOTr, CAAP launch P253‐M simulators to train air traffic controllers
ph.description: The Department of Transportation (DOTr) and Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP) have opened three new simulators to upgrade air traffic training and improve aviation safety. Transportation Secretary Giovanni “Banoy” Lopez and CAAP Director General Raul Del Rosario led the ribbon cutting for the new Aerodrome, Approach, and Enroute simulators worth P253 million. The facility replicates different phases of flight and actual air traffic control environments, allowing trainees to practice realistic scenarios in a controlled setting. Lopez said the initiative is part of DOTr’s push to upgrade aviation facilities and upskill personnel, ensuring passenger safety. He noted that CAAP’s air traffic controller program offers free specialized training with guaranteed employment for qualified graduates nationwide. Del Rosario added that the new equipment shortens the training program from nine months to six, easing the shortage of air traffic controllers at regional airports and addressing fatigue and attrition caused by overseas job offers. The simulators are expected to sharpen competencies in situational awareness, decision making, coordination, and communication, while reducing reliance on live operational traffic during training. Aligned with International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) standards, the upgraded systems reinforce CAAP’s Comprehensive Air Traffic Service Training Program through competency based, scenario driven instruction.

bd.title: Egypt Launches New Digital Visa-On-Arrival System for a Faster, Seamless Arrival Experience
bd.description: CAIRO , July 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Egyptian Ministry of Tourism & Antiquities today announced a new Digital Visa-on-Arrival System, a key step forward in modernizing entry procedures for international travelers. The pilot phase of the new system will begin on 1 August 2026 at Cairo International Airport (all arrival terminals) , the first of a nationwide rollout to other airports. A Faster, Fully Digital Entry Experience The system replaces the traditional paper visa sticker with a Visa QR Code, offering a faster, seamless arrival that reflects Egypt's commitment to smart, traveler-friendly experiences. How It Works Travelers can get their Visa QR Code via: The official online portal (live 48 hours before the pilot) The dedicated official mobile application Self-Service Machines at Cairo Airport's arrival halls The code can be generated before departure, mid-flight, or after landing, by the traveler or a travel agency. Officers scan it with the passport at the border, shown by email or printed. Each code stays valid for 48 hours from issuance. Pricing is set at USD 36 total : USD 30 current visa fee plus a USD 6 issuing fee. During the pilot, the digital system runs alongside the existing paper visa; once concluded, the sticker is phased out and the QR code becomes the sole entry method. Looking Ahead After the Cairo pilot, the government will extend the system to other airports in stages, with dates announced in advance. The Ministry encourages the travel industry to share this information with customers. bd.description: SINGAPORE , July 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Following a transformation of its kitchen, award-winning Modern Chinese restaurant Peach Blossoms at PARKROYAL COLLECTION Marina Bay, Singapore, welcomes guests back to home on Level 5. Marking this new chapter is the launch of the Black Pearl One Diamond Tasting Journey, an exclusive tasting menu inspired by the restaurant's prestigious recognition in the Black Pearl Restaurant Guide. Peach Blossoms’ Executive Chinese Chef Edward Chong Main Dining Hall of Peach Blossoms Led by Executive Chinese Chef Edward Chong, the new tasting menu is a celebration of Modern Chinese cuisine, thoughtfully woven with innovation and a deep respect for only the finest produce. Every course reflects the culinary philosophy that earned Peach Blossoms its coveted One Diamond accolade, showcasing sophisticated techniques and elegant presentation. Peach Blossoms’ Bird’s Nest, Squid Ink Pastry with Kaluga Queen Caviar The eight-course journey begins with cold-brew red tea, made in-house with black tea harvested from ancient tea trees that are over 100 years old. Guests are then welcomed with an exquisite Hamachi, Scallion and Chicken Rice Tart , where delicate slices of fresh Hamachi crown a crisp golden shell filled with fragrant chicken rice, topped off with caviar for a luxurious, savoury finish. This is followed by an indulgent Bird's Nest, Squid Ink Pastry with Kaluga Queen Caviar , pairing snow crab, bird's nest, hairy and luffa gourd enveloped in a pastry, complemented by premium 15-year Kaluga Queen caviar infused with aromatic minced ginger. The menu continues with a nourishing Marble Goby in Hakka Wine Essence , where the fish is slowly simmered to create a naturally collagen-rich broth, finished with honey beans and fragrant Hakka rice wine. The signature main dish presents Boston Lobster with Urban Farm Basil and Sticky Rice Cake , paying homage to the evolution of satay sauce. Confited in house-made lobster oil before being delicately char-grilled, the lobster is paired with a deeply flavourful sauce enriched with lobster broth, preserved radish and fresh basil harvested from the hotel's Urban Farm. A refreshing interlude follows with Wine-infused Chilled Crab with Citrus and Kaluga Queen Caviar , featuring sweet hand-picked crab complemented by an aromatic Dongqu wine jelly infused with aged tangerine peel, spices and sour plum, to awaken the palate. The culinary journey concludes on a comforting note with Crab Claw with Fermented Soy and Crisped Grain , inspired by the Hakka tradition of spicy fermented black bean flavours. Stuffed with Kurobuta pork and prawn mousse before being served atop crisped rice, the dish offers an elegant balance of savoury richness, sweetness and texture. Wuyi Oolong Tea, Monkfruit Jelly and Sesame , provides a sweet finale, celebrating the timeless pairing of premium tea with Chef's signature Peanut Ball. Available at S$268++ per person (minimum two diners), the Black Pearl One Diamond Tasting Journey also includes 2 packets of Chinese tea for guests to bring home. With the restaurant's return to Level 5 and the debut of the Black Pearl One Diamond Tasting Journey menu, Peach Blossoms invites diners to rediscover Modern Chinese cuisine through an immersive experience where culinary mastery and innovation come together in every course. About Peach Blossoms Peach Blossoms exudes a fresh and contemporary energy, serving modern Chinese cuisine with influences from Southeast Asia. With premium seasonal produce, masterful culinary techniques and artful presentation, award-winning Executive Chinese Chef Edward Chong breathes life into one of Singapore's top Chinese restaurants, earning acclaim by food connoisseurs and the elite business community alike. As one of Singapore's highly lauded Chinese chefs, renowned for redefining Chinese cuisine with his own innovative and contemporary interpretation, Chef Edward's story is one of transformation and dedication, from a novice to a culinary virtuoso, who now entices diners from across the globe with his modern Chinese cuisine. By combining trusted sovereign digital infrastructure with world-class AI engineering and enterprise transformation capabilities, Gulf Edge and Cognizant will help organizations deploy AI securely, responsibly, and at scale. The collaboration brings together Gulf Edge's leadership in digital infrastructure, energy, cloud, and strategic relationships across Thailand's most important industries with Cognizant's global expertise in AI, digital engineering, cloud modernization, data, and intelligent operations. Together, the two companies will deliver end-to-end AI capabilities spanning infrastructure, AI platforms, enterprise solutions, systems integration, and managed services. The partnership will initially focus on accelerating AI adoption across key sectors including banking and financial services, energy and utilities, healthcare, telecommunications, manufacturing, and the public sector. Through industry-specific AI solutions, organizations will be able to improve operational efficiency, enhance customer experience, strengthen decision-making, automate complex business processes, and unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth. Together, we will develop secure, resilient, and future-ready sovereign digital infrastructure while delivering industry-specific AI solutions tailored to the needs of Thai enterprises and public institutions. Mr. Ganesh Ayyar, President of Asia Pacific & Japan (APJ), Cognizant, said, "As Thailand works toward its ambition of becoming an AI-native economy, we see this partnership as a meaningful way to help contribute to that vision, not just through the projects we deliver, but by building lasting AI and technology capability inside the country. With Gulf Edge's market reach and Cognizant's AI Builder strategy and global delivery capability, we are positioned to deliver transformative outcomes for Thai enterprises across every major sector." pk.title: Authorities told to step up monsoon preparedness as rain-related deaths in Punjab, KP reach 43
pk.description: President Asif Ali Zardari on Thursday directed all federal, provincial and local authorities to intensify coordinated preparedness, rescue and relief measures in view of the ongoing monsoon rains as the death toll from rain-related incidents rose to 43 in Punjab and Khyber Pakjtunkhwa. According to a press release issued by the President’s Secretariat, the president directed authorities to “intensify coordinated preparedness, rescue and relief measures as the country enters a critical phase of the monsoon season, with increasing rains raising the risk of flash floods, cloud bursts, glacial lake outburst floods, landslides, river flooding and urban flooding in vulnerable areas”. He also “expressed deep sorrow over the loss of precious lives and damage to homes, infrastructure and property caused by the recent rains and related incidents”. The president directed the National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA), the Provincial Disaster Management Authorities (PDMAs), and provincial and local authorities “to maintain close coordination and ensure timely dissemination of early warnings”. He also called for “continuous monitoring of rainfall, river flows and water levels in upper catchment regions, particularly in Gilgit-Baltistan and Azad Jammu and Kashmir”, and directed downstream areas to make advance preparations for possible flooding. According to the statement, the president directed the authorities “to pre-position rescue and relief resources, ensure the protection of vulnerable communities and critical infrastructure and take necessary measures to protect tourists and visitors in areas at risk from flash floods, Glofs and landslides”. The statement added that the president emphasised “that all concerned institutions must remain vigilant and ensure an immediate response wherever lives or property are at risk”. He urged the public “to follow official advisories and avoid unnecessary travel to areas facing warnings of heavy rain, flash floods, landslides or other weather-related hazards”. The statement said President Zardari also appreciated the efforts of rescue workers and emergency personnel engaged in relief operations and prayed for the safety of people across the country. Punjab The Punjab PDMA said on Thursday that at least 21 people had died while 154 others had been injured in rain-related incidents across the province during the ongoing monsoon season. In a statement, the authority said 15 people were killed in building collapses, two due to being struck by lightening, three due to electrocution and one person drowned. It added that 38 houses sustained partial damage. PDMA Director General Umar Abbas Mela directed district administrations to remain on high alert during the second spell of monsoon rains, warning of the risk of urban and flash flooding. He said deputy commissioners had been instructed to strictly enforce Section 144 around rivers and streams and urged citizens to avoid staying in dilapidated or structurally weak buildings. The DG said most fatalities had occurred due to the collapse of weak roofs and unsafe buildings. He also advised parents to keep children away from electric wires, utility poles and low-lying areas, stressing that loss of life and property could be minimised by adopting precautionary measures. According to the PDMA, Lahore received 343 millimetres of rain over the past 48 hours, while water was cleared in record time from major roads, intersections and underpasses. KP In KP, the PDMA said that 22 people had died and 23 others had been injured in rain-related incidents July 9. According to the authority, the fatalities occurred due to heavy rains and flash floods that triggered the collapse of roofs and walls of houses and swept people away in floodwaters. The deceased included nine men, 10 children and three women, while the injured comprised 11 men, five women and seven children. The PDMA said 37 houses were damaged during this period, including 29 that sustained partial damage and eight that were completely destroyed. The affected districts included Peshawar, Nowshera, Khyber, Mardan, Buner, Bajaur, Shangla, Swabi, Lower Chitral, Lower Dir, Upper Dir, Abbottabad, Mansehra, Haripur, Tank, Torghar, Kurram, North Waziristan and South Waziristan. It said district administrations had been directed to immediately provide relief supplies and expedite assistance to affected families. The PDMA said water levels and flows in rivers and streams across the province were currently normal, but warned that intermittent heavy rainfall was likely to continue until July 23. It added that district administrations had already been directed to remain on alert. The authority urged the public to avoid unnecessary travel, refrain from visiting vulnerable tourist spots and follow weather advisories issued by government departments.

BANGKOK , July 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Cognizant (Nasdaq: CTSH), a leading AI builder and global technology services provider, and Gulf Edge Company Limited , the digital infrastructure arm of Thai energy and infrastructure conglomerate Gulf Development Public Company Limited (GULF) or Gulf Group , today announced a landmark strategic partnership. The alliance is designed to accelerate enterprise AI adoption and establish a resilient, AI-native digital economy in Thailand and the broader region. From left to right: 1. Mr. Thomas Mathew, Vice President, Head of ASEAN and Greater China, Cognizant 2. Mr. Ganesh Ayyar, President of Asia Pacific and Japan, Cognizant 3. Mr. Sarath Ratanavadi, Chief Executive Officer, Gulf Development Public Company Limited 4. Ms. Yupapin Wangviwat, Chief Financial Officer, Gulf Development Public Company Limited 5. Dr. Korn Poonsirivong, Head of AI Business, Gulf Edge Company Limited As artificial intelligence (AI) rapidly reshapes industries, economies, and societies worldwide, the partnership aims to establish the foundational ecosystem needed to enable Thailand's next phase of digital transformation. By combining trusted sovereign digital infrastructure with world-class AI engineering and enterprise transformation capabilities, Gulf Edge and Cognizant will help organizations deploy AI securely, responsibly, and at scale. The collaboration brings together Gulf Edge's leadership in digital infrastructure, energy, cloud, and strategic relationships across Thailand's most important industries with Cognizant's global expertise in AI, digital engineering, cloud modernization, data, and intelligent operations. Together, the two companies will deliver end-to-end AI capabilities spanning infrastructure, AI platforms, enterprise solutions, systems integration, and managed services. The partnership will initially focus on accelerating AI adoption across key sectors including banking and financial services, energy and utilities, healthcare, telecommunications, manufacturing, and the public sector. Through industry-specific AI solutions, organizations will be able to improve operational efficiency, enhance customer experience, strengthen decision-making, automate complex business processes, and unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth. Beyond enterprise transformation, Gulf Edge and Cognizant share a broader ambition of strengthening Thailand's position as a regional AI hub. The partnership is expected to attract global technology expertise, stimulate investment in advanced digital capabilities, and create high-value employment opportunities across AI engineering, data science, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, and digital transformation. The two companies also plan to collaborate with universities, research institutions, technology partners, and public-sector organizations to develop AI talent, promote responsible AI adoption, and foster a sustainable innovation ecosystem for the country. Mr. Sarath Ratanavadi, Chief Executive Officer, Gulf Development Public Company Limited, said, "Our partnership with Cognizant marks an important milestone in our vision of helping Thailand become an AI-native economy. By combining Gulf Edge's strengths in digital infrastructure, energy, cloud, and deep understanding of the Thai market with Cognizant's global expertise in enterprise AI, digital engineering, and transformation services, we are creating a comprehensive platform that enables organizations to adopt AI with confidence and generate measurable business outcomes. Together, we will develop secure, resilient, and future-ready sovereign digital infrastructure while delivering industry-specific AI solutions tailored to the needs of Thai enterprises and public institutions. We believe AI has the potential to transform every sector, creating new opportunities for productivity, innovation, and sustainable economic growth." Mr. Ganesh Ayyar, President of Asia Pacific & Japan (APJ), Cognizant, said, "As Thailand works toward its ambition of becoming an AI-native economy, we see this partnership as a meaningful way to help contribute to that vision, not just through the projects we deliver, but by building lasting AI and technology capability inside the country. With Gulf Edge's market reach and Cognizant's AI Builder strategy and global delivery capability, we are positioned to deliver transformative outcomes for Thai enterprises across every major sector." About Gulf Edge Gulf Edge Company Limited is the digital infrastructure arm of Gulf Development Public Company Limited, Thailand's leading energy and infrastructure conglomerate. Gulf Edge is building a robust digital ecosystem, spanning data centers, cloud services, satellite technology, and AI infrastructure, to accelerate Thailand's digital transformation and position the country as a regional hub for the AI economy. About Cognizant Cognizant (NASDAQ: CTSH) is an AI Builder and technology services provider, building the bridge between AI investment and enterprise value by building full-stack AI solutions for clients. Its deep industry, process, and engineering expertise enables it to build an organization's unique context into technology systems that amplify human potential, realize tangible returns, and keep global enterprises ahead in a fast-changing world. pg.title: New AI toolkits to guide PNG, Pacific governments under Australian funding deal
pg.description: PAPUA NEW GUINEA and its Pacific neighbours will soon have access to purpose-built tools to help them weigh the risks and rewards of artificial intelligence (AI), after Australia confirmed a funding package worth almost PGK1.3 million (AUD420,000) for the region. Unveiled during Pacific Cyber Week and the Digital Transformation Summit in Port Moresby, the funding will support the rollout of governance and risk-management toolkits under Australia's Southeast Asia and Pacific Cyber Program. The technical development will be handled by Standards Australia. Australia's Special Envoy for the Pacific and Regional Affairs, Ewen McDonald, speaks at the Digital Transformation Summit in Port Moresby during the event attended by government and industry representatives. Picture supplied by the Australian High Commission. The toolkits are pitched at government officials, policymakers and practitioners, giving them a working understanding of what AI can offer and where the dangers lie, while promoting its ethical and responsible use across Pacific nations. Ewen McDonald, Australia's High Commissioner to Papua New Guinea and Special Envoy for the Pacific and Regional Affairs, said the technology held real potential to strengthen public service delivery across a region long hampered by distance and thin resources. "Artificial intelligence can help improve public services and address the challenges of distance and limited resources," he said. The initiative is also designed to give Pacific nations more influence in international talks on AI standards, as countries around the world scramble to put guardrails around the fast-developing technology. It comes at a time when Australia itself is tightening its own AI rulebook. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has flagged a National Framework of Australian Standards for AI, which will introduce mandatory requirements for large-scale AI infrastructure and development within the country. An Office of AI is also being established inside Australia's Department of the Prime Minister and Cabinet to coordinate AI policy nationally. The Port Moresby summit further spotlighted a string of related projects, among them a planned PNG Digital Public Infrastructure Centre of Excellence, draft Pacific Digital and AI Principles, expanded online safety measures, and a National eSafety Symposium. Canberra reaffirmed its intent to keep working with Pacific partners on strengthening digital infrastructure, improving cyber resilience, building digital capability, and ensuring the region has a say in shaping how AI is governed globally. Australia's Ambassador for Cyber Affairs and Critical Technology, Jessica Hunter, said the guidance being developed would reflect the realities on the ground in Pacific nations rather than importing standards wholesale from elsewhere. "Responsible AI adoption requires practical and accessible guidance," Ms Hunter said. "The toolkits will help Pacific partners assess risks, strengthen governance and shape AI use in ways that reflect local needs, values and aspirations."

iq.title: أكبر حرائق إسبانيا تمتد إلى 32 ألف هكتار.. وإجلاء 34 قرية
iq.description: شفق نيوز– مدريد يكافح رجال الإطفاء في وسط إسبانيا حريق غابات التهم أكثر من 32 ألف هكتار، في واحد من أكبر الحرائق المسجلة في تاريخ البلاد، وسط استمرار عمليات الإخماد وإجلاء عشرات القرى. واندلع الحريق في منطقة ريفية بإقليم غوادالاخارا، بعد أقل من أسبوعين على حريق آخر في جنوب إسبانيا أسفر عن مقتل 13 شخصاً، بينهم أجانب، ويعد من أكثر حرائق الغابات فتكاً في تاريخ البلاد. وتفقد رئيس الوزراء الإسباني بيدرو سانشيز، أمس الأربعاء، المناطق المتضررة في غوادالاخارا، داعياً إلى ميثاق بين الأحزاب السياسية لمواجهة تغير المناخ. وقال سانشيز من قرية تماخون، الواقعة شمال شرقي مدريد، إن "تغير المناخ يقتل ويدمر الثروات في مجتمعاتنا عاماً بعد عام، وهذه ليست مسألة سياسية، بل مسألة علم وحقائق". وأُخليت نحو 34 قرية في المنطقة، فيما لم ترد تقارير عن وقوع وفيات أو إصابات خطيرة جراء الحريق. ويشارك أكثر من 200 رجل إطفاء، مدعومين بآليات برية وطائرات، في جهود احتواء النيران. وبحسب البيانات الرسمية، شهدت إسبانيا منذ بداية العام 22 حريقاً كبيراً للغابات، ويُصنف الحريق على أنه كبير عندما تتجاوز المساحة المتضررة 500 هكتار.

tr.title: Bursa Yıldırım Belediyesi binlerce hediye kartı dağıtacak! Detaylar belli oldu...
tr.description: Bursa Yıldırım Belediyesi, ihtiyaç sahibi vatandaşların kırtasiye ihtiyaçlarının karşılanması amacıyla hediye kartı yöntemiyle 6 bin adet kırtasiye desteği sağlayacak. İşte detaylar... Bursa'da eğitim dönemine yönelik sosyal destek çalışmalarına bir yenisi ekleniyor. Yıldırım Belediyesi Sosyal Hizmetler Müdürlüğü, hediye kartı yöntemiyle 6 bin adet kırtasiye malzemesi alımı için açık ihale usulüyle mal alım ihalesi düzenleyeceğini duyurdu. 4734 sayılı Kamu İhale Kanunu kapsamında gerçekleştirilecek ihale ile kırtasiye desteğinin hediye kart sistemi üzerinden ihtiyaç sahiplerine ulaştırılması hedefleniyor. 6 BİN ADET HEDİYE KARTI TEMİN EDİLECEK İhale kapsamında, 6 bin adet hediye kartı yöntemiyle kırtasiye malzemesi alımı gerçekleştirilecek. Bu yöntem sayesinde hak sahiplerinin, anlaşmalı satış noktalarından ihtiyaç duydukları kırtasiye ürünlerini hediye kartları aracılığıyla temin edebilmesi amaçlanıyor. İHALE 14 AĞUSTOS'TA YAPILACAK Yıldırım Belediyesi'nin düzenleyeceği ihale, 14 Ağustos 2026 Cuma günü saat 10.00'da gerçekleştirilecek. Elektronik teklifler EKAP üzerinden alınırken, tekliflerin açılışı Yıldırım Belediyesi Destek Hizmetleri Müdürlüğü İhale Toplantı Salonu'nda yapılacak. TESLİMATLAR HER AY YAPILACAK İhale şartnamesine göre sözleşmenin imzalanmasının ardından yüklenici firma 10 gün içerisinde işe başlayacak. Sözleşme süresi boyunca yüklenici tarafından toplanan hediye kartları, her ay düzenli olarak Yıldırım Belediyesi Sosyal Hizmetler Müdürlüğü'ne teslim edilecek. SADECE YERLİ İSTEKLİLER KATILABİLECEK İhaleye yalnızca yerli istekliler katılabilecek. Ekonomik açıdan en avantajlı teklif yalnızca fiyat esasına göre belirlenecek. Teklifi aşırı düşük bulunan isteklilerden ise Kamu İhale Kanunu'nun ilgili hükümleri kapsamında açıklama istenecek. EĞİTİM DESTEĞİNE KATKI SAĞLAMASI HEDEFLENİYOR Yıldırım Belediyesi'nin gerçekleştireceği kırtasiye desteğiyle, özellikle eğitim çağındaki çocukların okul ihtiyaçlarının karşılanmasına katkı sunulması hedefleniyor. Hediye kartı sistemi sayesinde hak sahiplerinin ihtiyaçlarına uygun kırtasiye ürünlerini seçebilmesine olanak tanınırken, sosyal destek uygulamasının eğitim döneminde ailelerin yükünü hafifletmesi amaçlanıyor.

tn.title: رئيس الجمهورية: ما يحصل من قطع للماء والكهرباء فضلا عن الحرائق ظواهر غير عادية.. والدّولة لن تقف مكتوفة الأيدي
tn.description: أشرف رئيس الجمهوريّة قيس سعيّد عصر يوم أمس، 22 من شهر جويلية الجاري بقصر قرطاج، على اجتماع ضمّ كلّا من خالد النوري، وزير الداخلية وصلاح الزواري، وزير التجهيز والإسكان والمكلف بتسيير وزارة الصناعة والمناجم والطاقة وعزالدين بن الشيخ، وزير الفلاحة والموارد المائية والصيد البحري وفيصل طريفة، الرئيس المدير العام للشركة التونسية للكهرباء والغاز وعبد الحميد منجّة، الرئيس المدير العام للشركة الوطنية لاستغلال وتوزيع المياه والعميد محمد رشاد السويسي، المدير العام للديوان الوطني للحماية المدنية. ووفق بلاغ لرئاسة الجمهورية، أكّد رئيس الدّولة في بداية هذا الاجتماع على أنّه يتابع عن كثب، على مدار اليوم والساعة، الأوضاع في كلّ أنحاء البلاد، مشدّدا على أنّ ما يحصل من قطع للماء والكهرباء فضلا عن الحرائق يمثّل ظواهر غير عادية، والدّولة لن تقف مكتوفة الأيدي أمام كلّ من يسعى إلى التنكيل بالمواطنين وتأجيج الأوضاع. كما تعرّض رئيس الجمهوريّة إلى قطع الماء والكهرباء الذي استمرّ في عديد المناطق إلى أكثر من أربع وعشرين ساعة وهو أمر يجب وضع حدّ له فورا، مع ضرورة إعلام المواطنين مسبّقا واختيار التوقيت المناسب للقطع إذا اقتضت الحاجة ذلك. وأثنى رئيس الجمهوريّة على الجهود التي تبذلها وحدات الحماية المدنيّة، بالتنسيق مع مختلف الهياكل العسكريّة والأمنيّة والإداريّة، والتدخّلات السّريعة والنّاجعة التي قامت بها لإخماد الحرائق والحدّ من انتشارها، مشيدا بما أبداه الجميع من عطاء غير محدود إيمانا بالواجب الوطني المقدّس. وخلص رئيس الدّولة إلى التّأكيد على الوعي العميق للشعب التونسي الذي ستتحطّم على أسواره كلّ محاولات التّنكيل مهما كان مصدرها ومهما إشتدّت ضراوتها.

zw.title: Girls just wanna have fun!: Women’s only Phinifa Festival returns
zw.description: Langa Dube, Gift Moyo THE countdown has begun for the second edition of the Phinifa Festival, a cultural celebration that is carving a niche as one of Zimbabwe’s distinctive platforms for promoting women empowerment. Set for August 15 in Bulawayo, the festival is expected to bring together people from across the country for a day that blends entertainment with cultural preservation, entrepreneurship and the celebration of womanhood. Festival hosts will include media personality MaNare and acclaimed content creator Dramatic Miss. Founded by Nobukhosi Hlahla, Phinifa Festival was established last year to promote Zimbabwe’s cultural identity while creating opportunities for women, creatives and small businesses to showcase their talents. She said the initiative is aimed at preserving cultural practices and ensuring they remain relevant while being passed on to younger generations. This year’s edition will run under the theme “Phinifa and Apron on Fleek”, placing the spotlight on traditional attire and Zimbabwe’s diverse culinary heritage. Hlahla said attendees can expect a vibrant showcase featuring traditional fashion displays, indigenous food exhibitions, live music performances, cultural dances, art exhibitions and a marketplace for local entrepreneurs.
